decision.changed_angle: The prior October11 Tesla item was a secondary ahead of the still-pending reveal. October14 now has the completed unveiling and newly eligible October12 investor disappointment plus October13 Optimus demonstration scrutiny. These change the operating question and attention debate, supporting a new lead despite family concentration; the price move alone is not the rationale.
